# Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Female Dancer in a Broadway Show

| sponsor = New York City Dance Alliance
}}
The Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Female Dancer in a Broadway Show was an annual award presented to a female dancer for their work on a Broadway production. The award was included when the awards began in 1982, as the Fred and Adele Astaire Awards.
The award was separated from Off-Broadway productions, which received its own category, in 2017, when the awards were renamed in honor of Chita Rivera. The award was replaced by the gender-neutral Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Dancers in a Broadway Show in 2023.
